content: Nehemías-sordamar e-isdarmalad-idu guakwaa ambikusmalad
Sanbalat itoargu, anmar Jerusalén-neggwebur-e-galu sobnanaiye, bela-bela sae-itoded, geb nue-uluded. Agine, Judíoʼmargi dododed.

Geb Sanbalat e-gwenadgan-wagab, degi, Samaria-sorda-bila-onomalad-wagab sogded: —We-Judíoʼmar, gegegana, ¿we, ibu-imaknanai? ¿Wede we-neggwebur-galu gannar sobmaloye sogmarde? ¿Ar Judíoʼmarde gannar e-Bab-Dummadga ibmar-ogumakar-uknai-guoye sogmarde? ¿Ar ibagwen-dummad we-arbaed gagamaloye sogmarde? ¿Ar akwa-gummaksamalad, bela ubigwar-gusmalad, gannar ebugoye sogmarde, we-galu gannar a-akwagi sobegar? Adi surbali.
Sanbalat weyob sogsagu, deunni, Amón-dule Tobías, e-dikarba gwichid. We-dule sogdemogad: —We-galu-akwabi-sobnanaidgi, achu-bunnu-wawaad egi nakwidele, yaar-nadeled.
Degi, an Bab-Dummadse goted:

content.text: Bab-Dummad, ar we-dulemar galu-sobnanaidgi sunnasur sunmaksamarsoggu,

content: Degisoggu, anmar anba galu-matusulid sobnai-guarmarsunnad. Ar dulemar bela-bela nue yeer-itogedgi arbanai gusmarsoggu, bato negabargus anmar galu onakmalad.

Ar Sanbalat, Tobías, Árabe-dulemar, Amón-dulemar, degi, Asdodʼginmalad itoarmargu, Jerusalén-neggwebur-e-galu-matusulid gannar soblenaiye, degine, galumar bato nue edilemaiye, amar nue bela-bela sae-itosmalad.
Degisoggu, we-dulemar igar-amismalad, adi, Jerusalénʼgi gwisgunamalagar, bela Jerusalén-neggwebur oichomalagar.
Geb degine, anmardi anmar-Bab-Dummadse goted. Degidgine, anmar igar-amisad, mutikidba, degi, ibginedba sordamar neggi-nakulegega ogwismaloye.
Deunni, Judá-yargi-bukmaladdi sogdemalad:

Degine, anmar-isdarmalad sogdemalad: “Melle anmar-wisguega anmar imakmalo, degi, melle anmar-dakega imakmarbalo. Judíoʼmar bato yaba-gudii anmar-dakdamaloed, geb agi, anmar oburgwemaloed. Deyob anmar imakoed, adi, melle galu-matusulid bar-nudakmalagar.”
Judíoʼmar-gwenna-gwenna amar-abargi-mamaimalad bali-bali anmarga sognonidamalad: “Sanbalat-sordamala ukiar bemargi galagwensuli baidsik-baidsik bemar-bukwadgi gwisgunonimaloye.”

Geb agine, dulemar e-gwenadgan-e-gwenadganba danar-danar an oambikusad. Guakwa es-suidgi gani-gani an oambikusad. E-sigu, e-gingi bato guar-guar gani, galu-matusulid-dikarba, bur-baisursunna-anmargi-ubogedgi an amar-urbisad.

Geb degidgine, neg nue an daksagua, an gwichiguded. Geb agi, dummaganga, sorda-idumaladga, degi, bela dulemarga an sogded: “Melle anmar-isdarmalad-abin gwayemalo. Nue insamalo, Bab-Dummad, dule-dummadid, bela-gangued-nika-maid. Be-gwenadgan-ular, be-masmala-ular, be-bunamala-ular, be-omegan-ular, degi, be-negyaur-ular be bila-onomalo.”
Anmar-isdarmalad wisguarmalad, anmarde guakwaa bukwamarye, ar e-igar-mesismalad Bab-Dummad ei obelosye. Agi, anmar gannar galu-matusulid sobdemalad, na egad-egad arbaed imakdemalad.

A-iba-onoded-akar, an-sordamar-negabar arbananai gusad. Abaladi, guakwaa e-ilawar-swiswidikmalad, e-sigu-abgaed, warsi, degi, e-binasgargi mor-esgorobiid-yoi gudii gusmalad. Judá-dummagan guakwa-bukwamarmogad e-sordagan-bendakega.
Dulemar galu-matusulid-sobnanaidi, degi, dulemar-ibmar-berbemaladi, sakwa-nailiki arbananai gusad, sakwa-baidsikdi eswar-gani gunanai gusad.
Ar dule-galu-sobnanaimaladdi, na e-sadergi es-suid-nai gunanai gusmarbalid. Deyob arbananai gusmalad. Dule gar-trompeta-ogoleddi an-dikarba gwichid.
Ar ade dummaganga, dule-nue-nug-nikamaladga, degine, bela dulemar-baiganga an sogsad: “We-arbaedi, arbaed-dummadid, bipisulid. Emide, anmar galugi banna-banna dika-dikasur gunanaid.
Degisoggu, ar bia gar-trompeta gole bemar itogoe, asik bemar anmarbogwa ambikunonimalo. Ar anmar-Bab-Dummad bila-onolegedgi anmar-ular gwisguoed.”
Degisoggu, deyobi anmar arbananai gusmalad. Dad-nakwialid-akar, neg-mutikguedse anmar arbaed indakdedamalad. Dule-negabala arbananai gusmalad, baigan-abaladdi eswar-gani guakwaa nakulebukwa gusmalad.
Geb degine, dulemarga an sogsabalid: “Bemala, be-bendakmaladmala Jerusalén-neggwebur-yaba be ambikumalo, adi, mutiki be nakulemalaga, ibgindi bemar arbamaloed.”
A-ulale, an-gwenadgan, an-sapingana, degi, sordamar-an-edarbemaladi, bipisaale binsa-gannaa-bukwadasurmalad, unnila obsokalirbi geb bogiguddamalad.
